question: If $a_{ij}$ and $A_{ij}$ represent the $(i,j)^{th}$ element and its cofactor of $\begin{bmatrix}2 & -3 & 5 \\ 6 & 0 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & -7\end{bmatrix}$ respectively, then the value of $a_{11}A_{21}+a_{12}A_{22}+a_{13}A_{23}$ is:
explanation:
**Step 1:** Recall the property of determinants relating elements and cofactors.

**Step 2:** The sum of the products of elements of any row (or column) with the cofactors of the corresponding elements of some other row (or column) is zero.

**Step 3:** Evaluate the given expression $a_{11}A_{21}+a_{12}A_{22}+a_{13}A_{23}$, which multiplies elements of row 1 with cofactors of row 2.

**Step 4:** By the property stated, this sum equals $0$.
